description: This file contains helper functions for encoding and decoding E1AP (E-UTRAN New Radio Access Technology Application Protocol) messages related to CU-UP (Central Unit - User Plane) in a 5G network, including functions for creating ASN.1 structures, validating requests, and filling request/response messages.

methods.name: cu_up_e1_setup_request_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a cu_up_e1_setup_request object to its ASN.1 representation for E1AP setup request.

methods.name: check_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_request_valid
methods.description: Validates an ASN.1 bearer context setup request message, ensuring it is supported and correctly formed.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_drb_to_setup_item
methods.description: Fills a driver data radio bearer setup item from ASN.1 data.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Fills a bearer context setup request structure from ASN.1 message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_setup_response
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 response message for bearer context setup from internal response structure.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Fills a bearer context modification request structure from ASN.1 message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_modification_response
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 response message for bearer context modification from internal response structure.
